characters.role: your best buddy who explores the valley with you
the friendly lost baby Triceratops you help

pages.text:
The sun is warm and the ferns are soft as you and {{FRIEND_NAME}} walk through Gentle Valley. Every dinosaur here loves plants, even the very polite T-rex who only munches giant watermelons.

By a mossy log you hear a tiny sniffle. It is a lost baby Triceratops named {{BABY_NAME}}, who cannot find the herd. "Do not worry," you say. "We will help you get home."

choices.text: Ask the polite T-rex for help

pages.text:
The footprints are as wide as dinner plates and lead toward a sparkling river. {{BABY_NAME}} trots beside you, sniffing every flower along the way.

At the water you see smooth stepping stones on one side and a gentle path along the bank on the other.

The polite T-rex is having a picnic of watermelons and offers you a big juicy slice. "A lost baby? Let me help," the T-rex rumbles kindly.

The T-rex points a tiny arm toward a tall hill, then toward a shady path by the river. "You can see far from up high, or walk soft and slow down low."

choices.text: Climb the tall hill to look around
Take the soft path by the river

pages.text:
From the high spot you can see the whole valley spread out like a green blanket. Far away, near a patch of purple berry bushes, a group of Triceratops is munching happily.

"That is your herd!" you cheer. {{BABY_NAME}} bounces up and down with joy.

choices.text: Call out a big friendly hello
Gather sweet berries to bring along

pages.text:
The gentle path leads you to a giant Brachiosaurus nibbling leaves from the treetops. "Hello down there," she says with a warm smile.

She is so tall she can see for miles. "I spot a herd of Triceratops by the berry bushes," she says. "Would you like a boost to look, or shall the little one hop up to sniff the way home?"

choices.text: Climb her long neck for a peek

pages.text:
You take a deep breath and call out a happy hello across the valley. Your voice floats over the ferns like a song.

The herd lifts their frilly heads and answers with gentle honks. {{BABY_NAME}} honks right back, wiggling with excitement.

choices.text: Wave for the herd to come to you

pages.text:
You gather a basket of the sweetest purple berries, and {{FRIEND_NAME}} carries a hat full too. {{BABY_NAME}} sniffs the air and follows the yummy smell.

The scent drifts all the way to the herd, and the big Triceratops raise their heads, sniffing back with delight.

choices.text: Set the berries down as a treat

pages.text:
You and {{FRIEND_NAME}} walk beside {{BABY_NAME}} through the tall grass, humming a happy tune. The herd trots closer, and a big mama Triceratops gives a soft, joyful honk.

{{BABY_NAME}} races into the middle of the herd for the biggest snuggle. Everyone is home at last.

choices.text: Join the happy herd for a while
Wave and head back to the T-rex

pages.text:
The whole herd comes strolling over, their frills bobbing in the sunshine. They circle around {{BABY_NAME}} and nuzzle the little one with gentle bumps.

The mama Triceratops looks at you with grateful eyes. "Thank you," she honks softly. "You are true friends of the valley."

choices.text: Have a picnic with the herd
Cuddle up for a cozy rest

pages.text:
The herd makes you and {{FRIEND_NAME}} honorary Triceratops for the day, decking your heads with little flower frills. You spend the afternoon rolling in soft ferns and splashing in the cool river.

As the sun sets, {{BABY_NAME}} gives you the biggest, gentlest nuzzle of all. In Gentle Valley, you will always have a home. The end.

The polite T-rex hears the good news and rolls out a mountain of giant watermelons for a valley party. Dinosaurs of every size share juicy slices under the twinkling stars.

You, {{FRIEND_NAME}}, and {{BABY_NAME}} laugh with sticky, happy faces. It is the sweetest party the valley has ever seen. The end.

The whole herd settles into a soft nest of ferns, and you and {{FRIEND_NAME}} snuggle right in the middle. {{BABY_NAME}} rests a sleepy head on your lap.

The warm breeze hums a lullaby, and everyone drifts into a happy dream. Helping a friend get home is the best feeling of all. The end.
